description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.schedule with system.user.editSchedule (or addSchedule when it does not exist yet) and refresh the data.schedules binding.

schedule.description: The full desired schedule as the flat BasicScheduleModel mirror: name, description, observeHolidays, allDays, repeatAlternating, startingAt, and per-day <day>/<day>Time pairs with explicit 24h ranges.

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow (persist with system.user.addSchedule); false for edits of an existing schedule.

oldName.description: Present only on a rename: the schedule's previous name. Persist by adding the new name and removing the old (see the ScheduleDemo reference script).
